title: messages.c:407: Transit Info parse rejects valid E=1 flag that write produces
description: lichen_rpl_transit_info_parse rejects data[0] != 0, but lichen_rpl_transit_info_write sets buf[2] = 0x80 (E=1 per RFC 6550 6.7.8). Any Transit Info option written by this code cannot be parsed by this code. The header comment confirms 'LICHEN always uses E=1', so the parse check is incorrect. Round-trip serialization is completely broken. Fix: Change line 407 from if (data[0] != 0) to if (data[0] != 0x80) to require E=1 as the LICHEN contract specifies.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed line 407 check from 'data[0] != 0' to 'data[0] != 0x80' to require E=1 flag as the LICHEN contract specifies. Also moved the comment before the check for clarity.
